subject.title: feat(workspace): lint and auto-fix code fences in markdown at write time

question: Should OpenClaw add workspace Markdown code-fence hygiene to write paths, and if so should the first supported behavior be default auto-fix, warn/doctor-only, opt-in config, or no core write-time mutation?
rationale: The request changes write-time semantics for user-authored Markdown and adds config/API surface, so automation should not choose the permanent product policy.

options.title: Design Opt-In Or Warn First
options.body: Keep this issue open for a parser-backed opt-in, warn-only, or doctor-lint design that avoids silent default rewrites until maintainers approve stronger behavior.

options.title: Approve Default Auto-Fix
options.body: Allow a future PR to mutate workspace Markdown by default, but require explicit config docs, skip API, upgrade proof, and parser coverage for nested fences and language inference.

options.title: Reject Core Write-Time Mutation
options.body: Close or redirect the idea toward doctor/docs tooling or plugin/workflow guidance if core should preserve submitted Markdown exactly.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Or Warn First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a parser-backed opt-in, warn-only, or doctor-lint design that avoids silent default rewrites until maintainers approve stronger behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily product and config/API policy for agent workspace writes, and current history makes steipete the strongest available routing candidate.
